closed_feedback_loops.name: 技能冷却永动环 (Skill Cooldown Engine)
closed_feedback_loops.bound_mechanism: SKILL.CooldownFloorSec = 0.3s + windups (0.15-0.25s) + card_again_now 1.5x momentum cost (though skills have 0 mandatory momentum cost unless card_paid_dash/overdrive!).
closed_feedback_loops.design_note: Wait: check momentum_cost on skills! In content.json abilities carry momentum_cost=25..35 ONLY for Overdrive/card_blood_price reference because APP_SPEC §3.2 states skills cost 0 momentum at base! Thus card_again_now (-35% CD, 1.5x cost) has ZERO downside unless using Overdrive or card_blood_price!

closed_feedback_loops.name: 普攻三段触发技能桥接环 (Combo3 -> Auto Q & Synthetic Skill Hit)
chain: card_fist_skill (45% free Q cast) + card_solid_punch (synthetic skill_hit)
closed_feedback_loops.bound_mechanism: card_fist_skill has drop_weight=6 (0.086% per slot!), making the most exciting hybrid loop nearly unobtainable in organic matches.

closed_feedback_loops.name: 血魔过量治疗护盾迸射环 (Blood Price -> Lifesteal -> Overfed Shield -> Reactive Plating)
chain: card_reactive_plating (35% shield AoE burst) + card_grow_fat (+18 permanent MaxHP per 100 heal)
closed_feedback_loops.bound_mechanism: Ferment reaction (60% heal cut) or Rot (25% heal cut), BUT 18/24 skills lack elements and only 1 non-opening skill has Rot!

closed_feedback_loops.name: 三阶勋章单键自触发反应环 (Tier-3 Medal Self-Reaction + WaveAfter + BlastReload)
chain: Single Skill Hit with Tier-3 Medal
Applies Primary + Deterministic Secondary Element -> Instant Reaction
card_blast_reload (-3s CD) + card_reaction_refund (+15 Momentum) + card_wave_after (applies 3rd random element bypassing ReactionLockSec=0.5s once)
closed_feedback_loops.bound_mechanism: Acquiring 3 identical medals is ~1-3% RNG gated, NOT skill-gated. Once assembled, collapses 2-skill elemental combo setup into 1-button spam.

closed_feedback_loops.name: 冲刺穿人刷新列车环 (Dash Contact Reset + Pass Through + Runaway Train)
chain: card_bump_reset (100% CD reset on contender contact) + card_bump_again (-1.5s all skill CDs)
closed_feedback_loops.bound_mechanism: CC root/stun interrupts dash; requires contender contact (50% refund on monsters); single miss puts D on 9.0s CD.

vocab_vs_mechanics_findings.name: 拳拳到肉
vocab_vs_mechanics_findings.issue: Bridge catalyst: turns every 3rd basic attack into a synthetic skill_hit, unlocking skill_hit cards for pure basic-attack builds.

vocab_vs_mechanics_findings.name: 双摊位
vocab_vs_mechanics_findings.issue: Hard-coded to 3 specific actives (school_bag, desk_fan, flyer_trap) yet shares generic 'ground'/'max_hp'/'element' vocab, polluting shop slots for unrelated builds.
